name: Tosa (Japan, town)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tosa town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised sprout with a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Tosa, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 July 1964.

features.role: Tosa town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised sprout with a vertical bar
